title: Count the Number of Consistent Strings
summary: Given a string of unique characters and an array of strings, count how many strings in the array are consistent with the given string by ensuring all their characters are present in the given string.
statement: Given a string of unique characters and an array of strings, count how many strings in the array are consistent with the given string by ensuring all their characters are present in the given string.
constraints: allowed contains unique lowercase letters; words are nonempty lowercase strings.
A word is consistent only when every one of its characters belongs to allowed.
hints: Consistency is set containment of each word’s characters.
Build the allowed set once and test every character of every word.
Count words for which all character membership checks pass.
All checks are necessary and together sufficient; processing entries individually preserves duplicates.
editorial: All checks are necessary and together sufficient; processing entries individually preserves duplicates.

tests.explanation: Only aaab and baa use no characters outside a or b.
Every listed word uses only allowed letters, giving seven.
